name: GitLab
description: Access projects, issues, and merge requests via GitLab's official MCP server.
notes: Uses GitLab's official MCP server (beta). Access to the MCP server must be allowed for the top-level group on GitLab.com, or for the instance on GitLab Self-Managed. OAuth uses dynamic client registration with the mcp scope. On GitLab Self-Managed the MCP endpoint and OAuth URLs are host-specific: edit the URL to https://<your-instance>/api/v4/mcp.
installHint: Prefer the OAuth MCP connection. The GitLab MCP server supports OAuth 2.0 with dynamic client registration using the mcp scope. For GitLab Self-Managed, edit the URL to https://<your-instance>/api/v4/mcp and make sure MCP server access is enabled for the instance.
